answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 32791 Country: India Title: Regarding Doing Istanja Question: I want to know the proper way of performing Istanja . Can , we use our left hand to bring down the istanja from the point of istanja . Please clarify it . Answer ID: 32791 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1083/1083/M=1432) Yes, you can use left hand, rather one should use only left hand for istinja. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
